---
title: inif.sequences
description: Find shared token runs across samples and replace them with sequence references.
reference: inif.sequences
---

The dedup pass finds contiguous token n-grams common to *all* samples and
replaces each match with a single sequence-ref token. Expansion is the
inverse. See [Sequences and deduplication](../concepts/sequences.qmd) for
the algorithm and tuning guidance.
